prompt: Build a two-piece hinge with axial retention: the fixed part carries the pin and a pin head, the moving leaf carries the bore, and the moving part must turn ±45° about the pin. The pin head must block the bore so that pulling the moving part 2 mm along the axis is prevented and it cannot come off (this is the trade-off between retention and disassembly: this part has to retain, not to be axially withdrawable). The two parts must export as separate solids. The source must accept the pose parameter hinge_angle and pose the moving part with it. The pin axis is Z through the origin; pin diameter 6 mm; the diametral clearance between the bore and the pin must be between 0.35 and 0.45 mm. Units mm.
notes: This task deliberately has no disassembly-path requirement: a captured part cannot also slide off, and requiring both would make the task unsatisfiable by construction.
axial-retention means the pull is BLOCKED. A hinge that comes apart passes disassembly-path and fails this.
